19: async function post<T>(auth: Auth, path: string, data?: unknown): Promise<T> {
20:   const response = await auth.request.post(path, {
21:     headers: {
22:       "x-csrf-token": auth.csrf,

43:     const issued = await post<IssuedPassword>(auth, "/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple/passwords", { label: "E2E DAV tracer" });
44:     expect(issued.clear_password).toBeTruthy();
45:     expect(issued.username).toBe(adminEmail);
46:     expect(issued.server_url).toBe(`${baseURL}/dav/`);

48:     // curl transcript (proof of the browser-to-API-to-DAV path):

51:     //       -H "Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s' '${issued.username}:${issued.clear_password}' | base64)"
52:     //

57:     //   <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:">
